originals.why: 'If you'll have been able to finish giving an excuse' is unnatural: nobody 'finishes giving' an excuse. Its old LEGO (dwi'n cael hi'n) was unrelated to esgus, and Korean has no tense that maps the future perfect 'os byddi di wedi medru' to exactly one Welsh answer
